messages:
maria (platform): quick sync — product wants a single comparison panel for experiments: baseline vs variant + runtime signals. thinking latency p50/p95, error rate, fallback count, and kv-cache-hit.
jon (runtime): SGTM. need to surface model-version, route, and region in each series. otherwise aggregations hide regressions.
alex (product): also want user-visible metrics: request queue time and response size. UX should let PMs flip between absolute numbers and delta%.
kevin (observability): question — do we compute deltas in dashboards or emit comparison metrics from runtime? both have tradeoffs.
maria (platform): prefer emitting raw signals and computing deltas in the panel for flexibility. but we should emit a few precomputed rollup metrics to assist alerting (e.g., rollout_fallback_count_by_variant).
samir (infra): runtime can add a tag label: experiment_id and variant. low overhead if we sample at 1% for heavy traces, full counts for fallback/errors. any objections?
ingrid (devex): if we add experiment_id label we must document it in the SDK and console filter dropdowns. I'll own docs + quickstart snippet.
jon (runtime): implementation detail: we already emit request_latency_ms{model_version,region,route}. We'll add labels: experiment_id and variant (optional). new metric names: rollout.request_latency_ms and rollout.fallback_count.
kevin (observability): naming note: prefer dot-separated domain like redwood.rollout.request_latency_ms to avoid collisions. also add histogram buckets for latency to support pXX in panels.
maria (platform): can we agree on label schema now? propose: experiment_id, variant, model_version, region, route, customer_tier. keep label set small.
alex (product): customer_tier is important for A/B decisions (enterprise vs self-serve).
samir (infra): fine, but runtime will only fill customer_tier when available — leave it optional.
jon (runtime): will add metric prefix redwood.rollout.* and labels as agreed. ETA: PR for instrumentation tomorrow, small change in statsd exporter.
kevin (observability): once metrics exist, I'll create a comparison dashboard template: left col absolute time series, right col delta heatmap; top-level alert panel with regression guardrail that fires only when variant delta > threshold AND sustained for 5m.
maria (platform): we also need the console UX: expose a one-click 'compare variant' that wires experiment_id and variant filters into the dashboard. ingrid to own wiring with console team.
ingrid (devex): noted. I'll add dropdowns and a saved view called "Experiment diff". Need a stable metric list from kevin.
kevin (observability): I'll publish the metric catalog entry and a Grafana JSON model. Also add example PromQL queries: 1) 100*(variant_error_rate - baseline_error_rate)/baseline_error_rate 2) rate(redwood.rollout.fallback_count{variant=~".*"}[5m])
alex (product): for rollout UX, can we have the panel show a regression severity badge (low/med/high) based on combined z-score of latency+errors?
jon (runtime): z-score calc should be in the dashboard (scripted transform). we can export a helper PromQL recording rule if you want it precomputed.
maria (platform): please add a recording rule for variant_vs_baseline_zscore, sample rate 30s. kevin, jon — coordinate on rule name and retention.
kevin (observability): will do. prefer retention 30d for comparison history.
samir (infra): note on cost: adding labels increases TS cardinality — recommend we only enable experiment labels for routes opted-in via config, not global by default.
maria (platform): agreed. rollout instrumentation will be opt-in per-service/route. we'll add an onboarding checkbox in the console when creating an experiment.
ingrid (devex): I'll draft the onboarding copy and screenshots. can someone add a short example snippet for the SDK that shows how to pass experiment_id/variant?
jon (runtime): example: ````
// attach experiment metadata to request
headers.set('x-redwood-experiment','exp-2026-03-01:variantA')
metrics.increment('redwood.rollout.fallback_count',{experiment_id:'exp-2026-03-01',variant:'A'})
````
kevin (observability): reminder: all metric instrumentation must include cardinality guidance in the docs. I'll add that to the catalog entry.
maria (platform): plan/checklist: 1) runtime PR adds labels+metrics (jon) 2) infra gating for opt-in (samir) 3) dashboard template + recording rules (kevin) 4) console wiring + onboarding (ingrid) 5) docs + SDK snippet (ingrid + jon) 6) product validation with small internal experiment (alex).
alex (product): timeline: want internal validation next week, public rollout in 3 weeks.
samir (infra): will gate opt-in rollout to avoid cardinality shock. start with staging only.
kevin (observability): I'll create a lightweight alert runbook: if metric cardinality spikes >3x during rollout, auto-disable experiment labels and page infra team.
mar ia (platform): :thumbsup: thanks all — next check-in after runtime PR lands.
SLO-bot: new alert configured: rollout_metric_cardinality_monitoring triggered only on staging environments.
